title: soughra ne likha baba tumhe qaab me dekha
body:
soughra ne likha baba tumhe qaab me dekha
<<MINI>>
bechain hai dil mera ye kya qaab me dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
baba mujhe ek qaabe pareshaa'n nazar aaya
baba mujhe ek hashr ka saama'n nazar aaya
<<MINI>>
bechain hai dil mera ye kya qaab me dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha hai ke ek dasht me tanha hi khade ho
paani bhi mayassar nahi pyaase hi khade ho
<<MINI>>
bechain hai dil mera ye kya qaab me dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha hai ke ek qaime me betaab hai maadar aur pyaas se betaab hai bhayya ali asghar
<<MINI>>
bechain hai dil mera ye kya qaab me dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha hai ke rote hue bhayya nazar aaye
kehte hai ke soughra tumhe lene nahi aaye
<<MINI>>
bechain hai dil mera ye kya qaab me dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
dekha hai chachajaan ke badle hue tewar
sab jang ke aasaar numayaa'n hai saraasar
<<MINI>>
bechain hai dil mera ye kya qaab me dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
kya tum kisi aafat me giraftaar ho baba phir kis lie tum aise dilafgaar ho baba
<<MINI>>
bechain hai dil mera ye kya qaab me dekha
